Oneliner

Obtain position and attitude data for the validation of re-entry prediction software plus camera.
Description

Obtain position and attitude data for the validation of atmospheric models and space object re-entry prediction software. Design, build, test and operate a CubeSat.

Obtain photographs of Europe and transmit them to the ground for public relations and outreach purposes. Generate data to validate space object re-entry prediction software.

Develop a CubeSat platform based on smartphone technology. Test fly parts of the internal structure that have been 3D printed.
